title: Abatacept versus hydroxychloroquine for prevention of rheumatoid arthritis in individuals with palindromic rheumatism: a randomized open-label trial
comparison_or_design: The primary PALABA prevention comparison in palindromic rheumatism.
observations_or_assays: Intensity of palindromic joint attacks on the reported VAS
time_scope: The 24-month trial period; use the source-defined pre-randomization reference interval for attack-intensity change.
excluded: Available-data-only/per-protocol analyses, time-to-RA and visit-specific trajectories
population_or_material: The modified full analysis set with failure imputation in seropositive palindromic rheumatism.
requested_items: Primary failure-imputed 24-month RA arm counts/proportions and risk difference/test; pre-randomization and 24-month period-level attack-intensity medians and comparison; 0–24-month remission counts/proportions/test using observed denominator in Supplementary Table 7. Exclude alternate logistic models, overall-cohort results and 0–12-month remission.
case_specific_rules: For remission use the endpoint-specific observed denominator in Supplementary Table 7. Derive its population membership from the source. Retain the primary reported risk difference and its CI, applying the shared rules for comparison direction.
